reviews.t: Much better suction of dust than from other dust collectors.
reviews.x: Much better suction of dust than from other dust collectors and very easy to clean. Very noisy. As far as comfort it's just ok. I am a professional manicurist and comfort matters too. There should be a cushion to place an elbow on it and then would be perfect.

reviews.t: Dont buy does not work...dust everywhere!!!!!
reviews.x: Soo this is an update the company did send me a replacement but i can honestly say that this device really does not collect dust , its messy and dust flies everywhere instead of the device sucking the fumes plus dust from drilled nail product, it does not do the job its intended to do , they need to re do the entire devices before putting it on the market ..plus it was too expensive on amazon too.ebay sells them for less than 40.00 ..but i would not take a chance on this product ...save ur lungs

Hands down the best dust collector I have ever bought. This doesn’t do anything for fumes, but that’s not an issue for me. It actually pulls the dust down and doesn’t allow it to escape through the sides or bottom like dust fans with bags. It’s louder than some but the noise is still one you can easily talk over. The filter is simple to remove and clean and doesn’t need to be replaced, as again this is not an odor air purifier, just a dust machine.

reviews.t: I bought the makartt nail suction dust extractor fan.
reviews.x: The only thing I liked about this was the price and design. It arrived with no instructions or any type of papers. It looked nice and the metal felt like it was good quality, until I picked it up and notice how light and flimsy it was. Also everything inside looks fragile. But the main reason why I gave this 1 star is that it arrived dead.  I dont recommend this fan to anyone.  I forgot to mention the charger felt cheap too.

reviews.t: TRY IT AS SOON AS YOU GET IT, AND IF IT CLICKS, IT IS DEFECTIVE. 100%
reviews.x: NEVER received it!!! AMAZON refunded my money, and  because of the great reviews I decided to purchase from another place. (Same Brand product) One of the reviews I saw, the girl had pressed the on switch and there was a "clicking" sound before the motor & fan kicked on. This device DID NOT work! The suction was at about 30% at best! (I immediately concluded this was a given sign of a defective product) Note: she purchased from Amazon, same EXACT link I initially did. Based on all other reviews;

This device is ok. It doesn't have much suction, but I noticed that my dust was more centralized rather than being all over the place. It is super loud. I normally like to have my clients watch TV when they are in the chair, but you can't hear the TV over the fan.
[[VIDEOID:831899fd7f7e6b3969d1b5d5a0ccc7a7]] I think mine is broken. I’ve put a video and it makes a lot of sound and it shakes a lot! Seller can you please resolve this problem!!
I love the design , but it’s does not work. I turn it on and the fan was barely move ! I return the item.

reviews.t: Loved it until there was a short in the power where the cord connects into the unit.
reviews.x: Update:  received a replacement dust control fan today out of the blue.  Very impressed that the company is standing behind their product.  A little louder than I wanted but when you are using the efile you don't notice it.  Noticed a huge difference with dust since I started using. Then I set in on its side while doing chemical services and it has really helped with the fumes!  But the last week it has had a play in the power where the cord hooks into the unit.  Have to shake the cord a little

reviews.t: Stopped working after less than 30 uses
reviews.x: I bought this 7 months ago. I only do 3-4 sets of nails each month. It worked great until last month when it shut off mid-servoce and won't turn back on. It is supposed to have a 1 year warranty, but I can't get any response from the seller. Not worth the money of it isn't going to last more than 6 months.

I'm a professional nail technician, and this item I purchased for personal use. It works great for that purpose, however, the suction is a little less than what would be needed if being used full time in a salon. Packaged well, not too noisy, and extra filter included. Overall, works great!

I have been using other fans that have really disappointed.  I thought the purpose of a fan was to suck in the nail dust, of all the ones I have tried, this is unique.  The dust falls into the filter, however, dust still flies in the air.  This is easy to clean, a bit loud though.

The only reason I gave it one star is because I had to vote....Unable to use!! There is a shortage in mine and the suction it’s not powerful AT ALL!!! Than When I go to return the product it doesn’t allow me to because it’s under review.
Total junk! Sent it back. Made a bigger mess then it was even worth. I'll just stick to the $30 ones that actually collected dust. Client's complained often at how uncomfortable it was also.
So when i turn it on it doesnt immediately turn on. The fan turns half way for a good 5 min or more then kicks on when it wants too.... Maybe i got a defected one?
Suction is ok, but the volume is a bit high and the filtration needs to be kept clean

When I first received this it was great. Until the filter was covered in dust. I emptied it out. Took a blow dryer to it and the dust is collected in the filter, but it’s also blowing all over the place as well. I used stronger pressure from an air compressors to blow the dust out and it came out, however, it’s not sucking the air like it did when I first got it. Solution? Buy more filters even if it hasn’t  been 2-3 months I thought it may be good to rotate out 3 different filters daily and use

[[VIDEOID:285c7ca26176f399fbfbdfaa88245e31]] Update review! Have been using this dust collector for some time now and let me tell you for those of you that have left a review about the machine having to suction it must be a defective item. Watch video!! 😲🤯 .......................................................................... I didnt like how it came in a white plain box with no instructions. First I thought it was defected because it didnt start but it takes a couple seconds to start and it

Don’t even waste your time looking up other fans! This is the only one that nail techs everywhere amateurs and DIYers love. The dust gets sucked onto a filter instead of into a bag so there’s nowhere for the dust to go except on the filter and it is amazing. The square shape of it is great doesn’t take up much room and it’s easy to store.The only thing is it takes it a second to kick on but I don’t care everything else outweighs that one little flaw best fan ever!!!

reviews.t: For a professional Nail Tech, this is awesome!
reviews.x: I’m a professional nail tech that works this machine for approximately five hours a day at 20 minute intervals. This machine never overheat or vibrates. After seven months there is a little ting in the hand a motor, so I’ve ordered a new one to replace this. I have not had to replace it as of yet though. This is the machine I recommend to other nail techs starting the business. I will buy again if necessary.

I read many reviews before purchasing and seems that mosts chief complaint was the lagging when you start it up. I too have the same issue. Clicks and clicks and then begins. Suction is just okay in my opinion. Sure it picks up some of the dust but not as powerful as I would like. Im afraid of returning and getting another the same way. For now will do the job. Great for a beginner.

I just received the nail dust collector last week and have used it on a few of my clients. So far I have been pretty impressed with it. I recommend emptying the Dust out of the filter between each client. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars because I have not been using it long enough and I don't know where to get extra filters.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the unit is defective or stops working, including fans that won't start, barely move, shake, or quit entirely.
Several reviewers say the device is loud or very noisy.
Opinions on dust collection are mixed: some praise strong suction and easy cleaning, while others say dust still flies everywhere and suction is weak.
Multiple reviewers report poor or nonexistent seller/customer service, including no response to replacement requests and warranty claims.
Some reviewers praise the design and note the company sent replacements, though others describe the build as light and flimsy.
